Spiced Cider

Served at: All Hallows' Eve (Halloween)

Serves 6Prep 10 minCook 20 min

Spiced Cider is a warm, aromatic beverage traditionally enjoyed during All Hallows' Eve (Halloween) celebrations. Its blend of apple cider with warming spices embodies the cozy, festive spirit of autumn and is perfect for gatherings on chilly October nights.

Ingredients

  • 1 gallon (3.8 L) apple cider
  • 3 cinnamon sticks
  • 4 whole cloves
  • 3 star anise pods
  • 1 orange, sliced
  • 1/4 cup (50 g) brown sugar
  • 1-inch (2.5 cm) piece fresh ginger, sliced
  • Optional: 1/2 cup (120 ml) dark rum or bourbon

Method

  1. Pour the apple cider into a large pot or slow cooker.
  2. Add the cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, star anise pods, sliced orange, brown sugar, and sliced ginger to the cider.
  3. Heat the mixture over medium heat until it begins to simmer, then reduce the heat to low.
  4. Let the cider simmer gently for 15 to 20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
  5. Remove from heat and strain out the spices and orange slices.
  6. If desired, stir in dark rum or bourbon for an adult version.
  7. Serve warm in mugs, garnished with a cinnamon stick or orange slice.

Tips

  • For a non-alcoholic version, omit the rum or bourbon.
  • Adjust the sweetness by adding more or less brown sugar to taste.
  • You can prepare this in a slow cooker on low for 2-3 hours to keep it warm during a party.
